brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Clear three-column information architecture pairs ingredient list, transformation canvas, and recipe meta in a legible, scannable way
Warm gradient endpoint card visually rewards the 'flow into dish' metaphor and anchors the timeline narrative
Colored ingredient dots create a lightweight legend system that could thread through the timeline edges
dominant_weaknesses: Step cards overlap and occlude each other ('Season Chicken' title clipped), breaking the timeline's readability and trust in the layout
Connecting flow lines are faint, inconsistent, and don't visibly carry ingredient colors into steps — undermining the core transformation concept
Vertical rhythm is awkward: huge empty gap between 'Combine & Simmer' and the final dish card wastes the canvas
fix_priorities: Resolve card overlaps with a structured node layout (grid or dagre) so every step is fully visible
Make ingredient-to-step flows literal: tint edges with ingredient dot colors and animate them merging into the final dish
Tighten vertical spacing and add a visible time axis so the 'timeline' reading is unambiguous
Strengthen typographic hierarchy on step titles vs. durations (currently durations feel like afterthought chips)
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral appeal from the gradient dish card outpaces behavioral clarity, while reflective payoff (the transformation metaphor) is promised but only half-delivered.
rationale.intent_fit: It gestures at the ingredients-flowing-into-dish brief but the occluded nodes and weak connective tissue keep it from truly functioning as a transformation timeline.
